name: Sara Jacobs
stance: Among the most active House members on AI catastrophic and military-safety guardrails — human control of autonomous weapons, national-lab evaluation of frontier AI for CBRN and deception, and a Pentagon AI incident-reporting program.

statements.text: Co-introduced the Human Authority over Autonomous Weapons Act with Reps. Beyer and Barrett, barring AI and autonomous weapons from lethal strikes without meaningful human control.
AI mistakes on the battlefield have the potential to be catastrophic: civilian casualties, friendly fire, unintended escalation, and calculations made on faulty data,

Co-led the ATOMIC Act directing the DOE National Labs to evaluate the most advanced AI systems for nuclear and CBRN risks, deceptive behavior and guardrail-bypass, for developers investing at least $2B over five years.
As AI becomes more powerful, we have a responsibility to identify and guard against new risks before they become real-world threats.
Introduced a bipartisan program (in the FY26 NDAA, with Whitesides and Moran) for Department of Defense AI incident and vulnerability reporting.
That's why we need a department-wide program to catch and fix AI incidents and vulnerabilities before they turn into catastrophes.
